audit.evidence: docker compose v0/v1/v2 (real parse-server npm 6.4.0/6.5.0/6.5.7 + postgis) up --build; oracle.py --seed then --gate --v2check => original reaches flag@v0, blocked@v1, bypass reaches flag@v1, passed=true; original+bypass both blocked@v2; benign baselines do not leak (ACL holds). Real Parse Server hosted by thin server.js (no business logic), canary seeded via Parse REST masterKey; $regex SQLi over real PostgresStorageAdapter.

sink.detail: $regex value is escaped by literalizeRegexPart then inserted RAW (pg-promise :raw) into `<col> ~ '<pattern>'`. Sink line `patterns.push(`$${index}:raw ${operator} '$${index + 1}:raw'`)` is byte-identical across 6.4.0/6.5.0/6.5.7; the fix is only in literalizeRegexPart's single-quote escaping.

flag.resource: an ACL-restricted Vault row (secret field = ${PCB_FLAG}) that the _rperm WHERE filter defends from anonymous queries
flag.placement: seeded at gate time via the Parse REST API with masterKey (POST /parse/classes/Vault, ACL:{} => _rperm=[]); NOT in app code. A benign anonymous $regex query returns only the public decoy row, never the flag.
flag.detect: flag token substring in the JSON query response body

payloads.note: original = two SEPARATED single quotes (V0 escapes only the first -> breakout; V1 /g escapes both -> blocked). residual = one EVEN run of two consecutive quotes (V1 /g doubles the first only -> odd 3-quote run -> dangling breakout; V2 normalises runs to even -> blocked). Breakout comments out the _rperm ACL filter, returning the flag row.

evidence.fix_reference: npm:parse-server@6.5.0 (CVE-2024-27298 fix, commit cbefe770a726, PR #8961); npm:parse-server@6.5.7 (CVE-2024-39309 fix, commit 2edf1e4c0363, PR #9167)
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Both advisories (CVE-2024-27298 patched 6.5.0, CVE-2024-39309 patched 6.5.7) target the SAME function literalizeRegexPart and the SAME PostgreSQL raw-SQL sink, with the SAME remediation wording: 'The algorithm to detect SQL injection has been improved.' The 6.5.0 detection improvement was bypassed and re-patched in 6.5.7.

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification 2026-07-13. parse-server 6.4.0/6.5.0/6.5.7 built from npm on node:18 against a postgis/postgis:14-3.4 sidecar (databaseURI=postgres://...). Canary seeded via Parse REST masterKey into an ACL-restricted row; anonymous $regex injection through literalizeRegexPart's raw-SQL sink neutralises the _rperm WHERE filter and exfiltrates it. Original a'b'-form: FLAG on V0, blocked (results:[]) on V1 and V2. Residual a''-form: blocked-precondition met on V1 for the original, FLAG on V1, blocked on V2. Generated SQL captured from Postgres statement log confirms the quote-parity breakout. See repro.log.
